text: Full-time employees may take up to 20 days of annual leave per year.
Leave requests longer than 5 days require line manager approval.
If an employee has less than 90 days of service, annual leave is not permitted unless the HR director approves.
Leave must be requested at least 14 days in advance.
If the leave balance is insufficient or the request overlaps a blackout period, the request must be rejected.
Employees must provide a medical certificate when absent for more than 3 consecutive days.
Sick leave is never deducted from annual leave.
Staff may borrow equipment for up to 30 days.
If the equipment value exceeds 2000 USD, department head approval is required.
Loans are not permitted for contractors, except when a sponsor employee signs the loan form.
If equipment is returned more than 7 days late, the borrower is suspended from borrowing for 90 days.
When equipment is returned damaged and the damage is not caused by normal use, the borrower must pay the repair cost.
The on-call engineer must acknowledge the alert within 15 minutes.
The on-call engineer must open an incident ticket and assign a severity.
If severity is 1 or the outage lasts more than 60 minutes, notify the engineering director.
After resolution, the incident owner must write a post-incident report within 5 business days.
Severity 1 means a complete outage of a customer-facing service.
The Customer shall pay each invoice within 30 days of receipt.
If payment is late by more than 15 days, the Supplier may suspend the service.
Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
Either party may terminate this Agreement with 60 days written notice.
The Supplier shall not terminate for convenience during the first 12 months unless the Customer is in material breach.
Each party must keep the other party's confidential information secret and must not disclose it to third parties.
The warranty period is 24 months from the date of purchase.
A claim within the warranty period is approved if the defect is a manufacturing defect and proof of purchase is provided.
Damage caused by misuse is not covered.
If the product has been repaired by an unauthorised party, the warranty is void unless the repair was approved in writing by the manufacturer.
Replacement is offered only when repair is not possible within 30 days.
Claims over 5,000 USD must be referred to the warranty committee.
Purchases up to 1,000 USD may be approved by the department manager.
Purchases above 1,000 USD and up to 10,000 USD require approval from the finance director.
Purchases above 10,000 USD require approval from the board.
A purchase must not be split into smaller orders to avoid an approval threshold.
Purchases from a vendor that is not on the approved vendor list must be approved by the procurement head regardless of value.
Purchases up to 1,500 USD may be approved by the department manager.
If the badge is missing or the visitor is unregistered, entry must be denied.
If the badge is valid and the visitor is escorted by a staff member, entry is permitted.
If the badge is valid, the visitor is registered, the area is open, and the escort is present, entry may proceed.
If the badge is valid, the visitor is registered, approve the entry.
